itineraries.title: Five days around Formentera
itineraries.intro: The sandbars and clear water of Formentera, with Ibiza across the strait.

days.note: Formentera’s harbour; bicycles to the lighthouse at La Mola.
The clearest water in the Balearics; lunch ashore on the sand.
The sand bar and lagoon between Formentera and Ibiza; anchor for the night.
The little fishing harbour below La Mola and the beach at Ses Platgetes.
Dalt Vila’s walls above the harbour, then a quieter anchorage for the night.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Ibiza to Formentera
itineraries.intro: A week between the two islands, changing register mid-week.

days.note: Dalt Vila’s walls above the harbour, then a quieter anchorage for the night.
The bay across from the old town.
The west coast and San Antonio.
Anchor beneath the great rock off Cala d’Hort for the sunset.
The clearest water in the Balearics; lunch ashore on the sand.
Formentera’s port; disembark or return to Ibiza.
